The masculine régulier ending does not contain the extra final e of H.

A left parenthesis precedes the long p stem; the o/u/r strokes and separate compressed sa are visible before the line break to structure.

The next cluster has a tall initial curve and two uncrossed middle rises; celle remains preferred to cette, but the separation as la plus an M-like form cannot be excluded. The first cluster has n, an apostrophe and the compressed est ending. Autre is a separate low word with its crossed t, followed by que with the long q descender. It is not induite par.

notes:
Content summary: This leaf treats the residue fields k(s) of non-generic points as finite extensions of k and associates conjugacy classes of subgroups of E_K with points s of S. It identifies the N_s′ with the decomposition subgroups discussed in the prose, considers sections of their extensions over E_k(s), and composes such sections with a given section. For a rational section f of U_K over S defined at s, the author claims that the resulting partial section is of the first kind and, as an effective operation on pi, is the one defined by f(s) in U_s(k(s)). A slanted marginal note proposes taking S to be the canonical regular complete model of K over k. The page ends with the isolated continuation word Dans. Layout and source work: one main prose paragraph on nineteen principal baselines, an oblique upper-left marginal note and another-hand folio97 below left. No author page number, display, diagram or drawing was found. The whole and both supplied halves were each read once, including agreed words; thirty unique crops were saved and inspected. The margin crop was rotated clockwise 39 degrees; its original rectangle is retained in crop_boxes.json and the rotation in crop_rotations.json. All other crop boxes are in original pixels. State and punctuation decisions: l’extension is live. Its apparent cancellation in C is a curved insertion leader above the letters, attaching de N_s′ sur after the word. The lower cancelled word is retained as \deleted{\unsure{ext|est}}. The distinct following stop remains outside the strike, followed by the raised effective; ext is preferred but is not certain. The long stroke in tant belongs to its t crossing/return, so en tant remains live. The cancelled est after pi remains doubtful. The cancelled initial word is ce|qui, while normalisateurs remains doubtful because the strikes merge letters. The underline on définie is retained. Both sous groupes occurrences have empty gaps, without a written hyphen. Tantôt and aussitôt each have an actual accent stroke; the modèle accent is uncertain because the preceding descender enters that zone. The three dots after E_k and after marginal k are retained, as are the comma after the first parenthesis, the period after donnée and the final point before Dans. Notation cautions: the subgroup symbol has a triangular live-looking outline, top crossbar/upright and dense upper-right overdraw. The base remains Delta/I; the blind audit additionally records a separate raised xi-like glyph with unresolved cancellation state and E|K in the retraced following target. The subscripts of both the inclusion target and the hooked-arrow target are capital K, supported by sharp branches and same-page contrasts with rounded lowercase k in k(s) and E_k. The lower target’s K index is retraced over a rounded stroke, but a separate deleted k is not recoverable. This does not resolve the separate E|K uncertainty in the earlier target’s main body. The capital K readings may conflict with an expected common base in the proposed section construction; they are not normalized. Likewise the extra live sur after the inclusion is not omitted for grammar. The low initial letter in obtenue and the e/s body of est are retraced without a securely separable earlier word. The blind audit retains the separate dense point after the lower target K as punctuation, before the following est. The equals short form is preserved; the uncertain celle/cette segmentation also admits la plus an M-like form; the equals sign is not expanded. Mathematical scope: only source reading, attachment tracing and same-page notation comparisons were performed. No proof of the assertion about specialization, first-kind sections, conjugacy classes or effective actions was attempted or used to force a reading. The check_events list is therefore empty. H’s final comment about rapid writing is editorial, not source text. Main review: the whole leaf and all thirty saved crops were visually inspected. Both target K subscripts are retained from their angular branches and lowercase controls. The l’extension leader stays above the live word; the stop after the cancelled ext|est is visibly beyond the strike and remains live. No grammar-driven change removes the extra sur or supplies hyphens in sous groupes. The base Delta/I overdraw and celle/cette/la-M segmentation remain open. The lower word is now relative; the raised word is extension|intérieure|extérieure after the blind audit. All supplied mark decisions and source difference rows were checked.

Blind adjudication inspected all twenty-five token-different boxes. Complet remains a full word; its l/t ending excludes comp. The live de|dé is moved before the lower cancelled normalisateurs, preserving line order. De|des after decomposition remains uncertain; tantôt is retained from its two t stems and circumflex. The full context confirms sections donc, composer, both f letters in the subject revision, aussitôt, obtenue, au dessus de, aussi and en tant qu-op., against the blind alternatives. A separate stop after the lower formula is restored. A faint point after et is left doubtful; cancelled inertie, the first cancelled est, and ext|est retain their obscured letters. The stop after the latter remains outside the strike, and raised effective is clear. No mathematical argument was used to choose these readings.
